posts.author: Thebeanguy
posts.body:
The Visualstella QTE plugin doesn't necessarily allow any changes to the QTE's art style. That design goes against the art style of my game, and I was wondering if there is a QTE plugin that allows changes to the design of it?
I use MZ.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Is the QTE on the map or in battle?
For battles, there's a MauiGameStudio tutorial
RPG Maker MV, MZ Timed Battle Events + Skills – Maui Game Studio
mauigamestudio.com
Or Synrec has a paid plugin
RPG Maker MV/MZ: Timed Attack by Synrec
Created timed attack sequences for your default battle system.
synrec.itch.io
